auditor_value: Mg − T = Ma and T = Ma ⇒ Mg = 2Ma ⇒ a = g/2 (5 m/s² at g = 10); T = Mg/2

findings.note: Adding Mg − T = Ma to T = Ma gives Mg = 2Ma, not 4Ma; the printed line is false, and taken at face value it gives a = g/4, which contradicts the a = g/2 written beside it. A student copying this line loses the step.

findings.fix: The text describes one pulley at the corner while the figure shows two fixed pulleys; in both layouts the string has one tension T and the blocks share one acceleration a, so apply Newton's second law to each block.
